items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: He used to play with Albert Nicklaus. We called him Wooden Joe. Yeah. Them two used to be together all the time. That was their band.

ctx.x: I was wondering about some more of the old trombonists like Joe Petit.

Oh, Joe Petit, he used to be a hard one, you know. He used to play with Albert Nicklaus. We called him Wooden Joe. Yeah. Them two used to be together all the time. That was their band. That band was named The Camellia.
Did Joe Petit ever play the slide or mostly vowel?
